control-label.purpose: Settings labels and emphasized compact actions.

shadows.name: page-arrow

shadows.name: bottom-sheet
shadows.purpose: Separates a mobile sheet from the obscured reader below.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Buttons, inputs, and page-arrow visual feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All documented state transitions become immediate under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Icon Action
components.description: The quiet default for header, sheet, and overflow actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-action" type="button" aria-label="More actions"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="19" r="2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-action { appearance: none; box-sizing: border-box; width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--th-layout-radius, 8px); background: transparent; color: var(--th-theme-text); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-icon-action svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-icon-action:hover { background: var(--th-theme-hover); color: var(--th-theme-onHover); } .ds-icon-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--th-theme-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-action:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-hover) 78%, var(--th-theme-text)); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-icon-action { transition: none; } }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A compact inverted action for submit, retry, load-more, and error recovery.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { appearance: none; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--th-theme-text); border-radius: var(--th-layout-radius, 8px); background: var(--th-theme-text); color: var(--th-theme-background); font: 650 0.875rem/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-action:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--th-theme-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary-action { transition: none; } }

components.name: Reader Text Field
components.description: The shared compact field treatment used by search, table of contents, and settings.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-search">Search publication</label><input class="ds-text-field" id="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Search" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--th-theme-text); font: 650 0.875rem/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.006em; } .ds-text-field { appearance: none; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-text) 16%, transparent); border-radius: var(--th-layout-radius, 8px); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-text) 4%, transparent); color: var(--th-theme-text); font: inherit; } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--th-theme-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Setting Option
components.description: A selected tile that combines tint, border, weight, and a checkmark instead of relying on color alone.
components.css: .ds-selected-option { appearance: none; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-text) 34%, transparent); border-radius: var(--th-layout-radius, 8px); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-text) 9%, transparent); color: var(--th-theme-text); font: 700 0.875rem/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-selected-option svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-selected-option:hover { background: var(--th-theme-hover); color: var(--th-theme-onHover); } .ds-selected-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--th-theme-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-selected-option { transition: none; } }

components.name: Progression Capsule
components.description: A deliberately secondary, centered reading-position status.
components.css: .ds-progression { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-text) 7%, transparent); color: var(--th-theme-text); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.25 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; text-align: center; }

components.name: Overlay Sheet
components.description: The roomier theme-derived container for settings, search, and navigation tasks.
components.html:
Display Settings

Reader controls remain compact inside a visibly roomier layer.
components.css: .ds-sheet { box-sizing: border-box; width: min(600px, 100%); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-text) 14%, transparent); border-radius: calc(var(--th-layout-radius, 8px) * 1.75); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-background) 97%, var(--th-theme-text)); color: var(--th-theme-text); box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgb(0 0 0 / 52%); } .ds-sheet-header { min-height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px var(--th-layout-spacing, 16px); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-text) 12%, transparent); } .ds-sheet-header h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 1rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.012em; } .ds-sheet-header button { margin-inline-start: auto; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--th-layout-radius, 8px); background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-sheet-header button:hover { background: var(--th-theme-hover); color: var(--th-theme-onHover); } .ds-sheet-header button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--th-theme-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sheet-body { padding: var(--th-layout-spacing, 16px); font: 0.875rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Page-Turn Affordance
components.description: A tall invisible interaction lane containing a compact circular directional control.
components.html: <button class="ds-page-turn" type="button" aria-label="Go forward"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m8.6 16.6 4.6-4.6-4.6-4.6L10 6l6 6-6 6z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-page-turn { appearance: none; box-sizing: border-box; width: var(--th-arrow-size, 40px); height: 40dvh; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--th-theme-text); opacity: 0.62; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 160ms ease-out; } .ds-page-turn svg { box-sizing: content-box; width: calc(var(--th-icon-size, 24px) * 0.8); height: calc(var(--th-icon-size, 24px) * 0.8); padding: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-text) 14%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--th-theme-background) 94%, var(--th-theme-text)); fill: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-page-turn:hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-page-turn:hover svg { background: var(--th-theme-hover); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 26%); transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-page-turn:focus-visible { outline: none; opacity: 1; } .ds-page-turn:focus-visible svg { outline: 2px solid var(--th-theme-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-page-turn, .ds-page-turn svg { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The reader feels like a carefully maintained library stack: calm, capable, bookish, and easy to navigate without competing with the work on the page. Chrome is modern and exact, but publication-first. It preserves the reader's established placement and behavior while making controls, settings, and layers feel more coherent and dependable.

The system gets its character from theme-derived near-neutrals, one-pixel structure, compact geometry, and disciplined density. Host-provided theme, layout, icon, constraint, and scrim variables remain authoritative. Publication typography and publisher styling remain inside the reading surface; system sans is reserved for reader chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Publication-first hierarchy with chrome that recedes until needed.
Near-achromatic surfaces derived from the active host theme.
Fine borders and restrained structural elevation.
Compact controls with visibly roomier overlays.
Accessible state changes with clear focus and non-color selection cues.
Stable placement and behavior across desktop and mobile layouts.

rules.name: The Borrowed Palette Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a fixed global brand color for reader chrome. Derive structure from `--th-theme-*` values and let publication content keep its own color voice.

rules.name: The Tint, Don't Paint Rule
rules.body: Create hierarchy with small text-on-background mixes; reserve solid ink fills for primary actions, active tracks, and compact playback controls.

rules.name: The Two Typesetting Domains Rule
rules.body: System sans belongs to application chrome; publisher and user-selected typography belongs to the publication. Do not make one impersonate the other.

rules.name: The Placement Is Product Rule
rules.body: Visual refinements may change density and material treatment, but they do not relocate reader actions, progression, navigation, or publication content.

rules.name: The Invisible Reach Rule
rules.body: Page-turn controls use tall invisible targets around compact circular arrows; never shrink the target to the visible disc.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface does not overlap the publication, use a fine rule or tonal shift instead of a shadow.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Drop shadows use neutral black, never theme foreground colors; theme text remains available for borders, focus rings, and control outlines.

rules.name: The Radius Ladder Rule
rules.body: Use 8px for controls, 12–14px for floating overlays, and 20px only for mobile sheet tops; pills and circles are reserved for inherently continuous or directional controls.

dos: Do let `--th-theme-*`, `--th-layout-*`, `--th-icon-*`, constraint, and scrim variables remain authoritative.
Do preserve publication-first hierarchy, existing component placement, keyboard behavior, RTL behavior, and responsive modes.
Do use one-pixel rules and restrained tonal mixes to organize dense settings and navigation.
Do pair every selected color treatment with weight, border, checkmark, inset outline, or another non-color cue.
Do provide a visible 2px focus outline and make reduced-motion state changes immediate.
Do size full-screen and sheet surfaces against the dynamic visual viewport where the implementation already does so.
donts: Don't introduce a fixed global accent or brand palette that the embeddable reader does not own.
Don't apply publication typography to application chrome or force chrome typography into publication content.
Don't replace the tall page-turn hit target with a small circular button target.
Don't use large shadows, ornamental decoration, or high-contrast surfaces for in-flow chrome.
Don't communicate hover, focus, selection, disabled, or loading state by color alone.
Don't change action placement, information architecture, host theming authority, or reader behavior as part of a visual refinement.
